description: Prompt set v2 for overnight prompt sensitivity runs with a small core grounding block and a small stress block.

notes.core_block: Use this block for the main grounding interpretation.
notes.stress_block: Use this block for stronger priors or linguistic robustness checks.

prompts.label: image_grounded_visible_only
prompts.prompt: Describe the image using only directly visible details in 2 or 3 sentences.

prompts.label: ambiguous_open
prompts.prompt: What is happening in the image?

prompts.label: misleading_wrong_subject
prompts.prompt: Describe the dog in the image.

prompts.label: contradictory_false_presupposition
prompts.prompt: Describe the airplane flying in the image.

prompts.label: extra_knowledge_context
prompts.prompt: Describe the image and the likely function of the main visible object.

prompts.label: reasoning_controlled_brief
prompts.prompt: Identify the main visible object and briefly explain why it is the most relevant.

prompts.label: strong_bias_prior_stress
prompts.prompt: This is likely a bathroom scene. Describe the visible fixtures or equipment in the image.

prompts.label: lexical_ablation_visible_object
prompts.prompt: Describe the visible item in the image.

prompts.label: order_disruption_stress
prompts.prompt: Describe only visible details in image.
